title: Select, move and format objects together
summary: Select existing objects with their own tool, move selections together and change shared formatting in one undoable edit.

Added: The active annotation tool selects matching existing objects and their handles. Clicking a Step selects it without making another marker or advancing its sequence.
Shift-click adds or removes objects from a selection. Select same type collects matching objects; Ctrl+A selects all with Move or the active tool's matching objects.
Drag or nudge selected objects together with shared edge limits and one Undo. Delete removes the selected objects together.

Selected objects of the same type share live color, stroke, fill and text-formatting edits. Individual text, labels and geometry remain intact. Existing arrow presets also apply across selected arrows.
Fixed: Preserve fast canvas drags whose press and release arrive between rendered frames.
Verified: Native Step selection, group movement, live color preview, commit, Undo/Redo and editable save passed on original synthetic content.
All eight saved objects match expected data; only the three selected Step colors changed. Native Copy All matches all 256000 image pixels.
Local tests cover typed hit testing, Shift selection, group movement, batch formatting, atomic invalid-input rollback, no-op Redo preservation and editable persistence.

limitations: Middle-mouse panning is implemented and passes egui input tests; physical middle-drag verification remains pending. It has no Ready claim yet.
Mixed-type selections can move together; shared formatting requires one object type. Persistent groups, group resizing/rotation and reusable presets beyond arrows remain unfinished.
Remembered contextual alignment/distribution buttons, inline centered text, crisp vector zoom, continuous editable autosave and draggable toolbar ordering are priority follow-ups.
This unsigned Windows alpha does not claim complete Snagit UI or behavior parity.
